lines.en: I flit up, then drop back down.

lines.zh: 翅膀太小，飞一会儿就得歇。
lines.en: My wings are small; I rest between flights.

lines.zh: 我沿着院子边走，绕一圈。
lines.en: I walk the yard's edge, one lap.

lines.zh: 我踩着火炭走过去，没事。
lines.en: I cross the coals and come to no harm.
I perch on your shoulder for a stretch.

lines.zh: 我飞过栅栏，在那边等你。
lines.en: I fly over the fence and wait on the far side.

lines.zh: 我在地上蹦了两下再走。
lines.en: I hop twice, then walk.

lines.zh: 我在雪上留了很浅的印。
lines.en: My prints in the snow are shallow.
I go with the wind to save effort.
I hit the curtain and swerve.
I hop in front of your boot.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边张嘴，热的。
lines.en: I walk with my mouth open; it's hot.
I sit on the hottest stone.
I open my mouth and let a thread of smoke out.
My scales feel warm to touch.
I spread my wings to sun them.

lines.zh: 我在试能不能吞下一块煤。
lines.en: I'm testing whether I can swallow a coal.
Fire is like wind to me.
I burp again and sparks come out.
I'm counting the layers of this fire.
There's lightning far off, and I look up.
I sit up straight, very proud.
I try not to smoke, and fail.

lines.zh: 这块石头凉了，我换一块。
lines.en: This stone cooled, so I find another.

lines.zh: 我睡着了，鼻子里还有火。
lines.en: I fell asleep with fire still in my nose.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖背，落下一层灰。
lines.en: I shake my back and ash falls off.
No burn on your hands — odd.
I'm sitting on your shoulder now.
Are you afraid of fire? I'm not.

lines.zh: 我碰一下你的袖子，会烧吗？
lines.en: If I touch your sleeve, will it burn?
I look up, and my eyes are bright.
The wind pushes your hair back.

lines.zh: 我可以给你看看我的火。
lines.en: I can show you my fire.
Don't lean back.
I fly right up to your eyes, close.

lines.zh: 我在你肩膀上留了个印。
lines.en: I left a mark on your shoulder.
Your breath carries cool air.
You're laughing at my size; I'm not that small.
I nibble your ear.
I'm not afraid of heights — are you?
Do you want to sit up here too?
I can see a little farther than you.

lines.zh: 我从上面看你，很有意思。
lines.en: You look interesting from up here.
My tail sways by your face.
Your collar is a little scorched.
I'm on your shoulder — not too heavy?
I give off a puff of smoke.
That knocked me askew.
My fire has shrunk a little.
I take off and dodge.
A pale line shows on my scales.
I flip once in midair.
I come down and steady myself.
My fire is still there; I don't mind pain.
I duck into the fire to recover.
I'll remember this.
Raw meat — I can bite through it.
Not enough; I've got an appetite.

lines.zh: 我飞下来，落在你手腕上。
lines.en: I fly down and land on your wrist.
Are you giving me the hot one?
I crunch it up, bones and all.
You can come a little closer.
My stomach is growling.
Eating this will make me hotter.
I hold it in my claws to eat.
Hold it steady and I'll aim true.

lines.zh: 我撞在你胸口，滑下去了。
lines.en: I hit your chest and slide down.
I was flying too fast to stop.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀折了一下，没事。
lines.en: My wing bent; it's fine.
You nearly swatted me down.
I land on your hat.

lines.zh: 这一碰，我身上掉了火星。
lines.en: Sparks fly off me at the impact.
I skim past your shoulder.
We could both pass without touching.
Your shoulder is rather hard.
I steady myself against you.
Another flies out of the smoke.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一团火打转。
lines.en: We circle the same fire.
Her wings are brighter than mine.
We perch side by side on the beam.
I share a little of my fire with her.
Two threads of smoke twist together.

lines.zh: 这个巢得放在热的地方。
lines.en: The nest must go somewhere hot.
We groom each other's wings.

lines.zh: 以后会有小龙从火里出来。
lines.en: Later there will be little ones out of the fire.
We watch that fire together.
This thing drags me downward.
I can hold the hot ones too.
I tuck the coal against my chest.
It's smoking in my claws.
I drop it into the fire and watch.
Can I eat this? I'll try.
Too heavy; I can only drag it.
I hug it and crouch.
It's burning, and I don't mind.
I'll bring it back for you.
That thing is moving; I see fire.
The fire has made my claws hot.
Its scalp looks thin.
Locked on, right over its head.
I fly one circle around it.
It can look up and still not reach me.
The fire is already in my throat.
I wait for it to show its back.
This time I'll burn its eyes.
Stand back; I'm diving.
I'm much faster than it is.
It sees me now, and it's too late.
I drop low and come in along the ground.
It's covered in fur; that burns well.
I wait for it to land first.
I'm coming down from above.
I swing around to the back of its neck.
I'll burn its feet first.
It spins looking for me and gets dizzy.
I'm half a block above it.
It can't reach up here.
I drop a little lower.
My fire is building.
It's running, and I keep pace.
The wind helps; I fly faster.
Hiding under a tree won't save it.
I burn one spot at a time.
It's already smoking.
One more circle, then I strike.
I have its eyes in sight.
This time I'll burn right through.
It's backed into the corner — good.
Fire leaks between my teeth.
I wait for it to breathe out.

lines.zh: 我俯冲下去，喷出一道火。
lines.en: I dive and breathe a streak of fire.
The fire catches its neck.
I bite its ear and shake.
My claws go in, hot.
I slam its chest and bounce off.
A patch of it is alight.
I breathe again, and the fire grows.
It swipes, and I slip through the gap.
That bite found soft flesh.
I climb and catch my breath.
The flames circle it.
My wing got singed.
My claws hook into its back.
I come again.
This time the legs.
I land back on your shoulder, done.

lines.zh: 火堆里裂开一声，我出来了。
lines.en: Something cracks in the fire, and out I come.
Hot stones hatch hot dragons.
I shake the ash off.
I open my mouth, and my first breath is smoke.
This fire is mine now.
I climb out of the lava.

lines.zh: 我飞到最高的那块石头上。
lines.en: I fly to the highest stone.
What is there to burn around here?

lines.zh: 岩浆锅边上，我挣开了壳。
lines.en: By the lava cauldron, I broke out of the shell.
I fly one lap around the room first.
Someone is watching me.
I land in front of you.

lines.zh: 我的鳞一出生就是亮的。
lines.en: My scales were bright from birth.
I'm not very good at landing yet.
Fire follows me.
I know the smell of chest wood.
I cry out, and it's loud.

lines.zh: 我先找个热的地方待着。
lines.en: First I'll find somewhere hot to sit.

lines.zh: 我本该不怕的，这火不一样。
lines.en: I should be immune, and this fire is different.
I hit the ground and roll twice.

lines.zh: 水里我发不出火，很难受。
lines.en: Underwater I can't make fire, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我抛上天，烟都散了。
lines.en: The blast throws me up and my smoke scatters.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我翅膀上，我飞不动了。
lines.en: An arrow pins my wing and I can't fly.
That light smothers my fire.
My belly is empty and my fire burns low.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我全身亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole body flashes.

lines.zh: 我在黑里往下掉，找不到火。
lines.en: I fall through blackness and can't find any fire.
